mechanism.claim: During high BTC range volatility, a six-hour directional move accompanied by unusually many executions but unusually small average quote notional per execution reflects broad late participation rather than a few informed inventory transfers. Fade the completed move for eight hours as small-ticket urgency exhausts.
mechanism.side: opposite strict sign of the completed six-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSTER uses the joint block-level geometry of high execution count and low quote-notional-per-execution. HVDVBR used concentration in one maximum-volume bar; STCSR used unavailable spot-versus-perpetual trade-count share; BAFR and MFIC used aggregate-trade aggressor direction and event topology. No prior event, control, threshold, or side is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the trailing twelve-hour BTC range must be in the source-only upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: execution-count/ticket-size participation tails are absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.decision: each completed xx:55 UTC five-minute bar
features.block: 72 exact consecutive completed five-minute bars ending at decision
features.range_window: 144 exact consecutive completed bars ending at decision
features.validity: finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative quote volume, finite nonnegative integer trade count, positive block quote volume and trade count; no imputation
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over 72 bars; strict nonzero
features.calibration: 2023H1 complete hourly anchors only: execution_count q75, average_ticket q35, abs(block_return) q60, range_vol q65; no candidate incidence or post-entry values
features.eligibility: execution_count>=q75, average_ticket<=q35, abs(block_return)>=q60, range_vol>=q65; first row of a consecutive eligible same-side run

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.live_extension: read-only Postgres completed one-minute bars aggregated exactly through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no count, ticket, move, volatility, onset, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
